M151 mark set, contact sheet

Nine marks

Five roles and four objectives on the 16 px master grid: 1.5 px stroke, round joins and caps, stroke only, currentColor. 24 px holds the stroke at 2 px. At 64 the grid, the live area (1 to 15, dotted) and the keylines (circle d12, square 11, diamond, triangle) are shown. Every mark stands beside its word.
